description: This file defines a React component 'WorkflowBreadcrumb' and a sub-component 'CopyableId'. It is used to display breadcrumb navigation for workflow execution details, allowing navigation back to workflows, sessions, and execution details. It also includes functionality to copy IDs to clipboard.

classes.name: CopyableId
classes.description: A React component that displays an ID label which can be clicked to copy the ID to the clipboard. It shows up to 8 characters of the ID with an ellipsis.

methods.name: CopyableId
methods.description: React component for copying an ID with visual feedback.

methods.name: handleCopy
methods.description: Handles the click event to copy the ID to clipboard and shows a temporary 'copied' indicator.

methods.name: navigateToWorkflow
methods.description: Navigates to the workflow detail page using the execution's workflow ID.

methods.name: navigateToSession
methods.description: Navigates to the session/execution list filtered by session ID, if present.
